note: Within the CD3-CD19- residual, CD7 × HLA-DR splits NK from myeloid APCs. NKcells: NK cells (lymphoid lineage within the non-B non-T residual) — cluster at the lower-right (CD7+, HLA-DR-). HLA-DRposCD7neg: antigen-presenting cells (monocytes and DCs; further parsed downstream) — cluster at the upper-left (CD7-, HLA-DR+). The lower-left (CD7- HLA-DR-) corner contains basophils and other residuals and is not categorized.
tips: Within the CD3-CD19- residual, CD7 × HLA-DR separates NK (CD7+, lymphoid) from myeloid APCs (HLA-DR+). NKcells: CD7+ HLA-DR- (CD7 is expressed on most NK cells — strongly on CD56bright NK, more variably on CD56dim NK subsets). HLA-DRposCD7neg: HLA-DR+ CD7-. The CD7- HLA-DR- quadrant (unlabeled) contains basophils and any remaining residual. Useful co-markers: CD56_Lu175Di is the classical NK marker and serves as a sanity check — most NK are CD56+; CD16_Tb159Di marks cytotoxic mature NK (CD56dim CD16+); CD161_Er168Di is expressed on NK cells (particularly CD56bright subset) and provides additional NK confirmation; CD123_Nd148Di is useful for identifying basophils in the unlabeled CD7-HLA-DR- residual (basophils are CD123+ HLA-DR- CD7-); CD33_Nd142Di is typically higher on the HLA-DR+CD7- myeloid fraction and low on NK.
